## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Canberra, Australia. It starts at 6 Gold Creek Rd.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Whether you're five years old with a Stegosaurus toy you can't put down, or a fully-grown adult, there's no denying how fascinating dinosaurs are! At the National Dinosaur Museum, guests can meet detailed recreations of Jurassic giants and see their real remains inside exhibits that place skeletons against prehistoric backdrops.
>
> After you've spent some time reading up on Cretaceous critters, head to the Dinosaur Garden and meet Stan, the National Dinosaur Museum's larger-than-life dinosaur who stands at six metres tall and stretches 20 metres from head to tail.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.85. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 105 ratings and 88 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
